subject: Azure marketplace: publisher identity proofs + manifest sanity check
content:
From: Priya Singh <priya@contoso.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Contoso Marketplace Team <marketplace@contoso.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure marketplace: publisher identity proofs + manifest sanity check

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Attached is the first-pass bundle from our legal/identity team: contoso-publisher-proof.pdf. We included the organization attestation and a notarized letter for the subsidiary.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the manifest properties we discussed (publisherDisplayName, offerId, planId) match the sample you need?
- Any blockers on the SPN / service principal delegation step from Redmond side? We can loop in our infra team.

We aim to have the offer live in the staging catalog by next Thursday (18th). Appreciate any early feedback.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Contoso Inc.

-----Original message-----
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Sent: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 17:45:00 -0800
To: Priya Singh <priya@contoso.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing timeline and checklist

Appreciate this, Priya — I'll review the bundle this morning and run a quick manifest sanity pass with Marissa.

I expect the common issues to be: SKU price tiers missing, incorrect asset URLs in the offer media block, and tenant claim mapping for the SPN exchange. If anything minor comes up we'll ask for a patch, not a reupload.

Logan
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference

---
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 09:36:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Contoso proofs + manifest

Forwarding Contoso's bundle. Marissa — can you run the manifest lint and highlight any field mismatches? Vivek — check the SPN onboarding steps (we need to confirm the audience + reply URLs Contoso will use). Laura — please validate the identity docs quickly against our publisher proof checklist.

Attachments: sample-offer-manifest.json, identity-proof-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Logan

> On Thu, 11 Dec 2025 at 10:02, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
>
> Thanks — I ran the JSON linter and got three items:
> 1) media.images[0].url uses a relative path (must be absolute HTTPS URL)
> 2) plan[0].meteringDimension is missing (required for transactable offers)
> 3) offer.tags contains an unsupported character (comma-separated string expected)
>
> I attached annotated manifest (sample-offer-manifest.json) with inline comments. If Priya can correct the URLs and add the meteringDimension and planId mapping we're likely good for staging.
>
> Marissa
> Marketplace Ops Engineer
> Redwood Inference
>
> -----Original message-----
> From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
> Sent: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 11:08:00 -0800
> To: Priya Singh <priya@contoso.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
> Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
> Subject: Re: Contoso proofs + manifest
>
> Quick note on SPN: Contoso should create the service principal with these constraints:
> - replyUrls must include https://contoso-app.contoso.com/.auth/login/aad/callback
> - appRoles: none required for listing, but the SPN needs Contributor role scoped to resource group used for billing hooks
> - tokenAudience: api://redwood-inference-contoso
>
> If they can share the appId and tenantId we can pre-seed the publisher claim and run the exchange in our sandbox to validate claims mapping (will save one round-trip during final publish).
>
> Vivek
> Director, Platform Partnerships
> Redwood Inference
>
> -----Priya replies (later same day)-----
>
> From: Priya Singh <priya@contoso.com>
> To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivev_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
> Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 12:29:00 -0800
> Subject: Re: Contoso proofs + manifest
>
> Thanks everyone — attaching an updated manifest with absolute image URLs and the meteringDimension added. Also attaching the notarized letter as contoso-publisher-proof.pdf. AppId and tenantId below:
> - appId: 3f2a6b8c-xxxx-xxxx-9b2d-0a1d2f3e4b5c
> - tenantId: 72f988bf-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2d7cd011db47
>
> We expect to deploy a staging resource group by Tuesday and can hand off the SPN to Redwood for a sandbox exchange.
>
> Priya
>
> -----Final email (12 Dec)-----
>
> From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
> To: Priya Singh <priya@contoso.com>
> Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
> Date: Fri, 12 Dec 2025 15:40:00 -0800
> Subject: Re: Contoso proofs + manifest
>
> Priya —
>
> Reviewed the notarized letter and the org attestation. Everything meets our publisher proof checklist except one missing line in the notarized doc (explicit marketplace use case statement). Can you add that sentence and reupload?
>
> Also, we validated the appId/tenantId in our sandbox and the initial token exchange worked as expected (saw issuer claim api://redwood-inference-contoso). I’ll schedule a short call with Contoso infra for Tuesday to finish the SPN role binding and finalize the manifest patch before you submit to the staging catalog.
>
> Laura Bennett
> Senior Program Manager, Marketplace Onboarding
> Redwood Inference

> Attachments referenced in thread: contoso-publisher-proof.pdf (notarized letter), sample-offer-manifest.json (annotated), identity-proof-checklist.xlsx
